item.title: Looking for an honest san serif font
item.description:
Hi guys,

I’m looking for a simple, honest and approachable san serif for use in body text. My idea is to have a journal feel but without being too themey. Something with the characteristics above that come together looking elegant. I loved the feeling of Frutiger on my page ( one of my faves) and although quite neutral it’s the complete opposite of what I want, its cold and distant and not really in line with the honest feel i’d like to convey.

item.title: Rounded edges font suggestions
item.description:
Hi there,
I’m working on a logo and need some help identifying the right font to use.
I’m looking for a sans-serif font with soft rounded edges, preferablly something with a single-stack lowercase “a”. I like the humanistic qualities of Avenir but obviously this font isn’t rounded.

I also like the style of the font in the new esurance logo, which I have attached below.

item.title: a Homely, honest , reliable,
item.description:
Hello,

This is my first post on here!

I wondered if you knew of a typeface that represented these sort of values of a person:

honest, approachable, reliable, the original ‘Mc’coy’, and homely

I wondered if a serif typeface said ‘stern’ too much, so maybe a Sans Serif is more appropriate

By ‘Original’ I mean someone that has been about for years but is still among the best but maybe needing to be more modern
